description: This file defines a Lightning JS component named 'Home' which constructs a webpage with animated logo, loader, and button using the LightningJS framework and Blits library. It includes component definitions, a template with UI elements, state variables for transitions, and lifecycle hooks to orchestrate animations and interactions.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the homepage with animated elements and attached behaviors.

methods.name: rotateColors
methods.description: Method to continuously cycle through predefined colors for the loader component, creating a color rotation effect.
